headline: Six scenes worth falling for
dek: A little coastal escape in Italy
editorial_intent: Replace an earlier passive still-photo Reel with a true swipe-controlled Instagram carousel combining six distinctive faithfully sourced Amalfi Coast scenes, including the dramatic Fiordo di Furore.
reader_scenario: A traveller browsing an inspiring Italy photo gallery, who can manually swipe beautiful scenes and save the real place names.

slide_count_rationale: Six different real Amalfi scenes: cover Positano, four different location/activity views, and one scenic Amalfi harbour CTA; every photograph belongs to the destination.
caption:
Cliffside towns, secret coves and that impossible blue sea. The Amalfi Coast really is something else. 🍋

📍 Positano — colourful houses stacked above the water.
📍 Ravello — peaceful gardens and a panorama of the coast.
📍 Amalfi Beach — umbrellas, Italian summer and the sea.
📍 Fiordo di Furore — a little cove beneath an iconic bridge.
📍 Path of the Gods — breathtaking coastal viewpoints.
📍 Amalfi waterfront — wander down to the boats.

Save this for an Italian escape.

Photos: Ian Mackey, nella n., Margo Evardson, Rolands Varsbergs, Sekwang Chia & Barbora Dostálová / Unsplash.
